title: Hypertrophy cut program
author: Arthur M.
desc: This Hypertrophy program was made to target every single muscle specifically, tear it down through exertion, and build it back stronger. I will be coupling this workout with an a workout titled; HYPERTROPHY AB DESTROYER. Supplement these workouts with a clean diet and strict meals to truly see your potential for change.
